up: Return the ChEMBL ID, canonical SMILES, exact IC50 value (in nM), and the PubMed ID or DOI for compounds tested against human Prostaglandin G/H synthase 1 (target pref_name 'Prostaglandin G/H synthase 1', organism 'Homo sapiens'). Include only rows where standard_type is 'IC50', standard_units is 'nM', and standard_relation is '=' (exact value).
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  md.chembl_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  a.standard_value AS ic50_nM,
  COALESCE(CAST(d.pubmed_id AS TEXT), d.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id
WHERE
  td.pref_name = 'Prostaglandin G/H synthase 1'
  AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens'
  AND a.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND a.standard_units = 'nM'
  AND a.standard_relation = '=';
